stages.rough: Edit of the concept. Keep the ring of eight rough wooden posts joined by two ropes each, the packed sand floor and the old iron-hooped barrel alone in the centre, all clearly readable. Make the posts a little thicker and the barrel head plain planks. Nothing else is added: a real village pastime ring, no joke. Keep the same three-quarter isometric angle, ink outlines and warm light from the top left. No people anywhere, no statues of people, no armour. No letters, no runes, no loose cloth, no hard-edged ground slab, a feathered patch of natural ground on the same footprint, no painted cast shadows, no grey smoke or fog. Matte paint, no gloss.
stages.solid: The same ring one step on, painted between rough and grand. The posts are now squared timbers with iron brackets, joined by taut rope and a plank rail, with one low bench of two planks on the back side and a plank entry gap at the front. The barrel in the centre is bigger and freshly iron-hooped, with an upturned wooden bucket beside it. Two iron torch stands at the front corners. The ring is still open on every side, no stands yet. Keep the same three-quarter isometric angle, ink outlines and warm light from the top left. No people anywhere, no statues of people, no armour. No letters, no runes, no loose cloth, no hard-edged ground slab, a feathered patch of natural ground on the same footprint, no painted cast shadows, no grey smoke or fog. Matte paint, no gloss.
stages.grand: Edit of the concept. Keep the open wooden arena: three tiers of timber stands curving around the back and both sides, the low plank wall around the sand, the stone footings, the iron torch stands, open toward the viewer at the front. Add in the centre of the sand the old iron-hooped barrel, as big as a table, with its plain planked head, so the eye finds it at once. Add a stiff clan pennant on a rigid wooden pole at the back of the top tier. Replace any red planks with plain brown timber. Keep the same three-quarter isometric angle, ink outlines and warm light from the top left. No people anywhere, no statues of people, no armour. No letters, no runes, no loose cloth, no hard-edged ground slab, a feathered patch of natural ground on the same footprint, no painted cast shadows, no grey smoke or fog. Matte paint, no gloss.
stages.mythic: Edit of the concept, going far further, an immense and lavish colosseum paid for by a whole kingdom. Keep the stone colosseum open toward the viewer, the front wall cut low so the sand and the barrel are fully visible. Make it much taller and wider: seven tiers of carved pale limestone arcades with columns, cornices and balustrades, two projecting wings on each side with their own arcades, round buttress towers at the corners with domed roofs, a grand stair and great bronze gates at the front, finely sculpted ornamental stone. Rising from the back, one truly vertiginous stone arch tower, three times the height of the colosseum, slender and stepped, reaching the very top of the canvas, with a lantern chamber. In the centre of the sand, an old iron-hooped barrel on a round stone dais, dry and solid, no holes, with strong orange-gold light blazing from every seam between its staves and rising as one wide dazzling column of golden light, as wide as the barrel, glowing at its core, up to the top of the canvas, warm orange glow washing the sand, the arcades and the tower. Large bronze braziers burn bright orange fire on every tier, readable by day. The arch tower carries only plain smooth stone pilasters and carved ornament, no bust, no statue, no standing figure, no sculpture of any person anywhere, only empty dark arches and plain carved ornament. No steam. Palette of warm cream stone, bronze and orange, no pink, no purple, no red. Keep the same three-quarter isometric angle, ink outlines and warm light from the top left. No people anywhere, no statues of people, no armour. No letters, no runes, no loose cloth, no hard-edged ground slab, a feathered patch of natural ground on the same footprint, no painted cast shadows, no grey smoke or fog. Matte paint, no gloss.
